expanded_council.subject: A round council table of dark wood with carved chairs, one new chair being added and glowing with golden light, a hanging lamp above.

grand_council.subject: A grand marble council rotunda with a crown resting on a round table surrounded by many high-backed chairs, golden light pouring from the dome.

royal_archives.subject: A royal archive vault with shelves of rolled decrees tied with red ribbons and wax seals, a new empty shelf glowing with light.

imperial_archives.subject: A towering imperial library with spiral shelves of bound books climbing into darkness, a single great tome glowing on a lectern.

open_markets.subject: The arched gates of a market hall swinging open to reveal lantern-lit stalls stacked with wares and bundled parcels.

grand_bazaar.subject: A vast domed bazaar interior glowing with hanging lanterns, gold coins, silks and treasure chests stacked around a central fountain.

swift_couriers.subject: A courier's winged boot and message satchel floating mid-stride in a rush of wind streaks, a road winding into the distance.

imperial_post.subject: An imperial post rider on a galloping horse passing a stone relay station at dusk, dust trailing, a glowing lantern on the station.

royal_treasury.subject: A royal treasury vault door with a violet crystal lock, piles of glowing violet influence gems and gold behind it.

sovereign_wealth.subject: A monumental golden treasury building with columns, coins stacked like pillars on its steps, sunlight gleaming off gold.

heavenly_mandate.subject: A golden imperial seal hovering in a beam of divine light descending from parted clouds, a laurel wreath around it.

eternal_mandate.subject: A radiant sun disc crowning a marble throne atop endless steps, rays of eternal golden light pouring down over the land.

scholarly_canon.subject: A single scroll case on a marble pedestal opening with a burst of blue light, a feather quill and ink pot beside it.

codified_canon.subject: Six great bound tomes standing like pillars in a circle on a dark ground, each glowing a different colour, a golden light rising from the centre.
